data.title: Twenty-five years of mTOR: Uncovering the link from nutrients to growth
data.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result

data.finding: Sabatini's 25-year synthesis linking nutrient sensing to growth through mTOR.
data.abstract_excerpt: In my PNAS Inaugural Article, I describe the development of the mTOR field, starting with efforts to understand the mechanism of action of the drug rapamycin, which ~25 y ago led to the discovery of the mTOR protein kinase. I focus on insights that we have contributed and on work that has been particularly influential to me, as well as provide some personal reflections and stories.

extracted_findings.effect: Personal historical account of the mTOR field from rapamycin's mechanism to discovery of the mTOR kinase
